name: Kling AI: Kling V2
description: Kling 2.0 (2024) was Kling's image/video model aimed at cinematic output. It introduced higher resolution outputs and smoother camera movements than Kling 1.x. The model generated realistic motion and stable scenes, with a focus on high-quality visual polish. Compared to the later 2.1, Kling 2.0 was a solid general-purpose model but had fewer advanced features (e.g. no multi-frame generation). It supported both image and text prompts for 720p/1080p animations. In effect, Kling 2.0 provided film-like AI videos that set the stage for even more advanced models.
